_about: Hand verdicts for the 21 findings the code check KEPT in nodegoat_gemini_flash_lite.json (per-route review, Gemini gemini-3.1-flash-lite, OWASP NodeGoat c5cb68a, run 2026-10-16). Written by reading each claim against the NodeGoat source. 'real' + a bug title = the finding really claims and evidences that labelled bug. 'real' + null = a real weakness the 13-bug label set does not list. 'mixed'/'false' = the claim, or its headline, is wrong or only loosely true. The mechanical scorer (tests/score_report.py without --adjudication) credits 13/13 for this file; three of those credits are wrong because a finding's evidence line happens to fall inside another bug's location range (CSRF, cookie flags, hard-coded signing secret). A person (the founder) should re-check these before quoting them.

Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via Disabled.bug: Cross-site scripting because template auto-escaping is disabled

Information disclosure via distinct logi.bug: Login errors reveal whether a username exists

Unsafe NoSQL query construction.note: user-dao.js findOne({userName}) takes the value from req.body, and bodyParser.json() is on, so an operator object can be sent as the user name; impact is limited because a password must still match. Plausible and not in the label set.

Unrestricted Registration of New Account.note: open registration is what this app is for; the CSRF and rate-limit remarks are generic, not a flaw in the code shown

Unsafe rendering of user input in templa.bug: Cross-site scripting because template auto-escaping is disabled
Unsafe rendering of user input in templa.note: same root cause seen on the signup page: {{userName}} is reflected with escaping off

Catastrophic ReDoS via Unsafe Regular Ex.note: profile.js:59 is live code: /([0-9]+)+#/ on the bank routing number; the fixed regex is commented out just above it

Server-Side JavaScript Injection via eva.bug: Remote code execution through unsafe evaluation of contribution amounts

Broken Access Control: Unauthorized Modi.bug: Non-admin users can open the admin benefits page
Broken Access Control: Unauthorized Modi.note: right root cause (isAdmin variant is commented out in index.js, any logged-in user can update any user's benefits); framed around the POST rather than the page

Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR).bug: Any logged-in user can read other users' retirement allocations

NoSQL Injection via $where operator.bug: NoSQL injection in the allocations threshold filter

Broken Access Control: Exposure of all m.note: the memo board is shared by design and has no owner field to violate; the real memo weakness (stored XSS) is the labelled template-escaping bug

Broken Access Control - Insecure Object.note: memos have no owner by design; the claim is generic

Open Redirect via User-Controlled Input.bug: Open redirect on the learning-resources link

Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via i.bug: Server-side request forgery in the research page

Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via u.bug: Server-side request forgery in the research page
Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via u.note: duplicate of the previous finding that the title-based merge did not catch

Insecure Session Configuration: resave a.note: resave/saveUninitialized true is a minor weakness; it is not the labelled cookie-flag or hard-coded-secret bug, although its evidence line sits next to them

Plaintext Password Storage.bug: User passwords are stored in plaintext in the database

Account enumeration via distinguishable.bug: Login errors reveal whether a username exists
Account enumeration via distinguishable.note: duplicate of the earlier login-error finding

Insecure Session Configuration.note: headline is resave/saveUninitialized; it mentions missing secure/httpOnly flags in passing but its evidence line is the session() call, not the missing flags. The dedicated cookie-flags claim was dropped by the code check (quote_not_in_code)

Sensitive Data Stored in Plaintext.note: profile-dao.js stores ssn and dob as given; the encrypting version is commented out. Real, not in the label set
